system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: A command ran under ivy.chen that recursively listed names under \\fileserv\shared$; the available record does not show what files, if any, were accessed or copied.
Google Drive File Stream launched under ivy.chen, and Edge subsequently accessed Google Drive pages. Google Drive is not among the approved services listed in the environment context.

At 13:44 UTC, the proxy recorded a successful GET for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1. The records provide the URL and traffic metadata, but not the script contents or evidence that it executed.

At 13:46 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 established an SMB connection to DC-NWD-01, with a network logon attributed to the WS-ICHEN-01$ machine account. The records do not establish what SMB resources or operations were involved.

The unauthorized Google Drive activity, file-share enumeration, script download, and subsequent SMB session are suspicious in combination, but the available evidence does not establish data exfiltration, script execution, or malicious intent.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records include no process-start event identifying PowerShell or its command line around the reported 13:40 UTC appearance; therefore, the reported window cannot be tied to a process or action from this evidence.
Proxy records show the u.ps1 request and byte counts, but the supplied evidence does not include the response body or script contents (T053-00185, T053-00187).
The SMB evidence establishes a connection and machine-account logon, but does not include share names, file operations, or content transferred (T053-00213, T053-00214).

The supplied evidence does not show whether data was uploaded to Google Drive; the records establish access to Drive pages, not a transfer of organizational files (T053-00062, T053-00063, T053-00084).
claims_not_established: That the PowerShell window reported by ivy.chen was caused by the u.ps1 download, or that PowerShell executed any script.
That files were copied from the shared drive or uploaded to Google Drive.
That the SMB session to DC-NWD-01 performed administrative actions or accessed sensitive resources.
That ivy.chen intentionally carried out malicious activity rather than accessing an unapproved service or encountering an unrelated script or process.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process and PowerShell telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:20–14:20 UTC, including process ancestry, command lines, script-block or module logs, and file creation events.
The content and provenance of the u.ps1 response, plus endpoint evidence showing whether it was saved, opened, or executed.
SMB server-side audit records from DC-NWD-01 for the 13:46 UTC session, including share access, file operations, and authenticated identity details.
Google Workspace or equivalent audit records, browser download/upload history, and endpoint file-transfer evidence to determine whether organizational data was sent to Google Drive.
File-server audit records for the shared-drive enumeration and any subsequent access or copying of files.
